name: jobradar
description: Hirevia — AI-Powered Job & Opportunity Discovery — searches 8+ sources, scores with local LLM

scripts.start: npm run setup && node -e "const p=process.platform; if(p==='win32'){require('child_process').execSync('cd dashboard && python -m uvicorn app:app --port 3000',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})}else{require('child_process').execSync('cd dashboard && bash run.sh',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})}"
